examples: It is trite to say that the mere fact that a decision does not favour the applicant or that the applicant disagrees with the decision does not establish that the decision is tainted with bias.
wiktionary.gloss: So well established as to be beyond debate: trite law.

blocks.etymology: Unadapted borrowing from Latin tritē, from Ancient Greek τρίτη (trítē, literally “third [string]”).

wiktionary.gloss: A denomination of coinage in ancient Greece equivalent to one third of a stater.
In Ancient Greek musical theory, the lower-pitched of the two movable notes in the farther tetrachord on a lyre, pitched lower than the paranete and higher than the paramese.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English triumphal, triumphall, tryumphal, from Latin triumphālis and Old French trionfal, triumphal.

thesaurus.definition: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success

wiktionary.gloss: Of, relating to, or being a triumph.
That celebrates or commemorates a triumph or victory.

senses.definition: the practice of staying away from school without permission

examples.en: The school introduced strict measures to reduce truancy among teenagers.
examples.vi: Nhà trường đã đưa ra các biện pháp nghiêm ngặt để giảm tình trạng trốn học ở thanh thiếu niên.

senses.vi: sự trốn học

thesaurus.definition: failure to attend (especially school)

wiktionary.gloss: The act of shirking from responsibilities and duties, especially from attending school.
Not belligerent.
To cook insufficiently.
To underdo.

examples: Near-synonyms: sous-chef, subchef, underchef, chef de partie, station chef, line cook (all sometimes synonymous)
wiktionary.gloss: A subordinate cook.

senses.definition: Feeling unhappy because you have not achieved what you wanted or developed your abilities.

examples.en: She felt unfulfilled in her boring office job.
examples.vi: Cô ấy cảm thấy không toại nguyện với công việc văn phòng nhàm chán của mình.

senses.vi: không toại nguyện; không thỏa mãn

senses.definition: Not carried out, completed, or provided as promised or expected.

examples.en: He made many campaign promises that remained unfulfilled.
examples.vi: Ông ấy đã đưa ra nhiều lời hứa tranh cử nhưng chưa từng được thực hiện.

senses.vi: không hoàn thành; chưa thực hiện

thesaurus.definition: of persons; marked by failure to realize full potentialities

vi_block: Không hoàn thành, chưa làm xong, chưa làm tròn (nhiệm vụ... ); không thực hiện (lời hứa, lời tiên tri... ).
Không thành, không đạt, không toại (nguyện vọng, ước mong... ).

wiktionary.gloss: Lacking fulfillment; marked by a feeling of failure to achieve goals or desires.
Not yet provided as promised, particularly with respect to a contract or an order for a supply of something.
Unable to be paused.

blocks.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin vulva, earlier volva (“womb, female sexual organ”), probably from volvō (“to turn, wrap around”). Akin to Sanskrit उल्ब॑ (úlba) and उल्व॑ (úlva, “womb”) or English valve, valva and other descendants of the Latin term (evolve, involve, revolve).

thesaurus.definition: external parts of the female genitalia

translations.header: collectively the external female sexual organs
translations.words: âm hộ; lồn; bướm; nữ căn

wiktionary.gloss: The external female genitalia of humans and other placental mammals, which includes the clitoris, labia, and vulval vestibule/vulvar opening.
A protrusion on the side of a nematode.

thesaurus.definition: any tree of the genus Pterocarya; fruit is a small winged nutlet; Caucasus to southeastern Asia
a threaded nut with winglike projections for thumb and forefinger leverage in turning

wiktionary.gloss: A nut with wing-like projections to provide leverage in turning with thumb and forefinger.

thesaurus.definition: thinks about unfortunate things that might happen

examples: You are such a worrier! I'm sure everything will turn out all right.
wiktionary.gloss: A person who worries a great deal, especially unnecessarily.
A person who causes worry in others.
An animal that seizes or shakes another by the throat.

blocks.etymology: From the Biblical story in Daniel 5, where, during a feast held by King Belshazzar, a hand suddenly appears and writes on a wall the following Aramaic words: מְנֵא מְנֵא תְּקֵל וּפַרְסִין (mənē mənē təqēl ūp̄arsīn, “numbered, numbered, weighed, and they are divided”) (Daniel 5:25). Daniel interprets the words as pointing to the downfall of the Babylonian Empire.

examples: He could see the writing on the wall months before the business failed.
She should have seen the writing on the wall when her boss suggested a change of career.
wiktionary.gloss: An ominous warning; a prediction of bad luck.

thesaurus.definition: in a yearning manner

wiktionary.gloss: With yearning; with desire; longingly.

a unit of information equal to 1024 exbibytes or 2^70 bytes

wiktionary.gloss: One sextillion (10²¹, or 1,000,000,000,000,000,000,000) bytes or 1,000 exabytes.
A zebibyte.
A person sexually attracted to non-human animals.
A person who in their ethical propositions puts animals on a level with humans.
